t5 (deployment path inspection) COMPLETE — read-only, nothing modified/deployed.

Key results:
1. Git: origin=https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat.git, main is 4 commits ahead (f01bac1, 8b99dea, f4af222, 64b5874). Push verified working (gh authed as xalor888; `git push --dry-run` OK: b486b69..f01bac1).
2. ⚠️ Hygiene blocker before any commit: `.agent-teams/` is untracked and NOT gitignored — a plain `git add -A` would push team state (inbox messages) to the PUBLIC repo. Add `.agent-teams/` to .gitignore first. (LiquidPress.kt is new source, fine to commit.)
3. Deploy model: Docker Compose (Caddy TLS 80/443 → Ktor :8080 internal + Postgres 16 + optional coturn). Server container is read-only, cap_drop ALL, healthcheck /health/ready. Named volumes postgres_data/server_uploads/caddy_data/caddy_config. Production enforces HTTPS BASE_URL==PUBLIC_HOST, JWT_SECRET≥32; RELAXED_VERIFICATION=true waives SMTP/TURN/PUSH.
4. Ops scripts run ON the server at repo root: deploy.sh (idempotent, --doctor preflight, auto-generates .env), update.sh (backup→pull→rebuild→redeploy), status.sh, backup/restore-production.sh.
5. 🚫 SERVER ACCESS BLOCKER: ~/.ssh/config_maodou has alias `maodou` → root@64.90.12.166:22, port 22 OPEN, but key auth denied — no private key on this machine, ssh-agent empty. Automated deploy is impossible until the user provides an SSH key/password. Also no Docker on this Mac (deploy runs on server, not local).
6. Ready commands once creds exist: local `git push origin main`; server: `bash scripts/deploy.sh --doctor` → `bash scripts/deploy.sh --host <PUBLIC_HOST> --email <EMAIL> --relaxed` (or `bash scripts/update.sh` if stack already deployed). Open firewall 80/443 (+3478/49160-49200 UDP if TURN).

Ask the user for SSH access to 64.90.12.166 (key or password) before the deploy step; I cannot proceed without it.
